claims.claim: Placeholder/example URLs used in code samples (your-domain.com, your-app.com/mini-app, example.com/webhook, api.telegram.org/bot<token>/setWebhook with a templated host) are illustrative placeholders, not factual endpoint claims. The real Bot API host pattern is documented at core.telegram.org/bots/api. Covers these references: https://your-domain.com https://your-domain.com/webhook https://your-domain.com/webhook/${process.env.WEBHOOK_SECRET} https://your-app.com/mini-app https://example.com/webhook https://api.telegram.org/bot${BOT_TOKEN}/setWebhook?url=https://your-app.vercel.app/api/webhook&secret_token=${SECRET}
claims.raw_snippet: Telegram Bot API Follow on X Home FAQ Apps API Protocol Schema Telegram Bots Telegram Bot API Telegram Bot API The Bot API is an HTTP-based interface created for developers keen on building bots for Telegram.
claims.verified_via: reference-coverage entry; snippet is a contiguous sentence from its source page

claims.claim: BotFather rotates a bot token with the /token command; there is no /revokentoken command.
claims.raw_snippet: If your existing token is compromised or you lost it for some reason, use the /token command to generate a new one.

claims.claim: Privacy mode is enabled by default for all bots added to groups except bots added as admins; disabling it requires re-adding the bot to the group.
claims.raw_snippet: Privacy mode is enabled by default for all bots, except bots that were added to a group as admins (bot admins always receive all messages). It can be disabled so that the bot receives all messages like an ordinary user (the bot will need to be re-added to the group for this change to take effect).

claims.claim: getUpdates and webhooks are mutually exclusive, and undelivered updates are not kept longer than 24 hours.
claims.raw_snippet: There are two mutually exclusive ways of receiving updates for your bot - the getUpdates method on one hand and webhooks on the other. Incoming updates are stored on the server until the bot receives them either way, but they will not be kept longer than 24 hours.

claims.claim: An empty allowed_updates list delivers all update types except chat_member, message_reaction, and message_reaction_count (omitting it keeps the previous setting, see allowed-updates-omit-keeps-previous).
claims.raw_snippet: Specify an empty list to receive all update types except chat_member, message_reaction, and message_reaction_count (default).

claims.claim: For Telegram Stars invoices provider_token must be an empty string and prices must contain exactly one item.
claims.raw_snippet: Pass an empty string for payments in Telegram Stars.

claims.claim: The prices array must contain exactly one item for Telegram Stars payments.
claims.raw_snippet: Must contain exactly one item for payments in Telegram Stars.

claims.claim: A gift sent by a bot via sendGift cannot be converted to Telegram Stars by the receiver; convertGiftToStars is a business-bot method requiring the can_convert_gifts_to_stars right.
claims.raw_snippet: The gift can't be converted to Telegram Stars by the receiver.

claims.claim: convertGiftToStars requires the can_convert_gifts_to_stars business bot right and a business_connection_id.
claims.raw_snippet: Converts a given regular gift to Telegram Stars. Requires the can_convert_gifts_to_stars business bot right.

claims.claim: logOut must be called before running a bot against a local Bot API server, and locks the bot out of the cloud server for 10 minutes.
claims.raw_snippet: You must log out the bot before running it locally, otherwise there is no guarantee that the bot will receive updates. After a successful call, you can immediately log in on a local server, but will not be able to log in back to the cloud Bot API server for 10 minutes.

claims.claim: Telegram.WebApp.sendData is only available for Mini Apps launched via a Keyboard button.
claims.raw_snippet: This method is only available for Mini Apps launched via a Keyboard button.

claims.claim: Mini App initData should additionally be checked against auth_date to prevent use of outdated data.
claims.raw_snippet: To prevent the use of outdated data, you can additionally check the auth_date field, which contains a Unix timestamp of when it was received by the Mini App.

claims.claim: The optional text of answerCallbackQuery is limited to 0-200 characters; no response deadline is documented.
claims.raw_snippet: Text of the notification. If not specified, nothing will be shown to the user, 0-200 characters.

claims.claim: BusinessBotRights.can_reply is scoped to private chats that had incoming messages in the last 24 hours.
claims.raw_snippet: True, if the bot can send and edit messages in the private chats that had incoming messages in the last 24 hours

claims.claim: subscription_period is a createInvoiceLink parameter and must currently always be 2592000 (30 days).
claims.raw_snippet: The number of seconds the subscription will be active for before the next payment. Currently, it must always be 2592000 (30 days).

claims.claim: Bot API 10.2 disallows Mini App methods from origins other than the original Mini App domain, automatically enabled for all Mini Apps on July 20, 2026, with an opt-out via the BotFather Mini App.
